caption: Uetliberg, Zurich
composition: Uetliberg summit terrace over Zurich and Lake Zurich · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Uetliberg summit terrace, Zurich spreads between wooded hills and Lake Zurich runs south. Beech woods at the summit are still mostly green, with only the first late-September turn. Under the fully overcast Open-Meteo model the distant Alps stay faint or hidden, and the city and lake remain the readable view. No readable billboard is featured.

Gate2: exact 1920×1080 / 864×1080; on-image 'Uetliberg, Zurich', scenario '24 September 2026 · 15:09 Europe/Zurich', disclosure and 'Jason D's Vision' signature bottom-right, legible; weather retrieved 13:08:46Z for scenario 15:09 — fresh same-day pull, 100% cloud consistent with the overcast view. Gate3: text-prompt-only, no photographic inputs. Gate4: no identifiable people or readable billboards (documented only). Gate5: no blockers.

Rework: fetch Open-Meteo fresh per scene (own HTTP request, own recorded timestamp), scenario hour inside the model-valid hour; update the approvals note with the new retrieval evidence; re-push masters only if on-image text must change.
